bool.answer_format: Answer with one JSON object: {"moment": true or false, "cue": "the exact words of the new user message that make it a correction, or an empty string", "confidence": "low", "medium" or "high"}

score.answer_format: Answer with one JSON object and nothing else: {"score": an integer from 1 to 10, "cue": "the exact words of the newest user message that carry the correction, or an empty string"}. 1 means it is plainly not a correction, 10 that it plainly is, and 5 or 6 that it could be read either way.

why_score.answer_format: Answer with one JSON object and nothing else: {"why": "one or two sentences: what the agent had done, and what the newest message does to it", "score": an integer from 1 to 10, "cue": "the exact words of the newest user message that carry the correction, or an empty string"}. 1 means it is plainly not a correction, 10 that it plainly is, and 5 or 6 that it could be read either way.

score_neutral.answer_format: Answer with one JSON object and nothing else: {"score": an integer from 1 to 10, "cue": "the exact words of the newest user message that make it a MOMENT_A, or an empty string"}. 1 means it is plainly not a MOMENT_A, 10 that it plainly is, and 5 or 6 that it could be read either way.
